turns.text:
real quick can u edit this msg to my boss and shift lead. its about the new overtime schedule

"hey carla and jose, wanted to flag my schedule since ot started. im now on mandatory 10 hour nights sun-thu 9 pm-7:30 am. my pay shows 24.75 with the 1.50 peak bump so i know its all lined up on my end. i carpool with trevor in his corolla now, $20 a week gas, so i cant really change start times. gym is cut to two sessions a week fri/sat mornings during overtime. i have class mon/wed/thu afternoons, how does this fit with the dock schedule?"

Happy to tighten that up. Here's an edited version:

"Hi Carla and Jose,

I wanted to check in about my schedule now that overtime has started. I'm working the mandatory 10-hour nights, Sunday through Thursday, 9 p.m. to 7:30 a.m. I carpool to Ridgeline with a coworker, so my start and end times aren't flexible. I also have classes Monday, Wednesday and Thursday afternoons, so I wanted to ask how my assignments and any schedule changes can work around those days.

Thanks,
[your name]"

I trimmed the gym and gas details since they're not really your supervisors' concern. Want me to put them back in?
yeah the pay line, does it sound like bragging? thats why i put it in. also i cant take morning calls, my sleep window is 8:30 am to 1:30 pm now and its often cut short on class days. can u add that

Yes, the pay line could read as a bit boastful, and it doesn't relate to the question you're asking. If you want to confirm your pay is correct, that's better as a separate note to payroll or HR. I'd leave it out here.

Here's the version with your sleep window added:

"Hi Carla and Jose,

I wanted to check in about my schedule now that overtime has started. I'm working the mandatory 10-hour nights, Sunday through Thursday, 9 p.m. to 7:30 a.m. I carpool to Ridgeline, so my start and end times aren't flexible. I have classes Monday, Wednesday and Thursday afternoons, and I sleep from about 8:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m., often cut short on class days, so I can't take calls in the morning. Text or a message on the board is best.

Could you let me know how my assignments can fit around those class days?

Thanks,
[your name]"
ok good. can u make it shorter tho, short version

Here's the short version:

"Hi Carla and Jose,

Quick note on my schedule: I'm on the mandatory 10-hour nights, Sun-Thu 9 p.m.-7:30 a.m., and I carpool so my start time can't move. I have class Mon/Wed/Thu afternoons and sleep 8:30 a.m.-1:30 p.m., so no morning calls please, text works. How does this fit with the dock schedule on those class days?

Thanks,
[your name]"
